label: w136-d1-unavailable-ledger-read
command: SELECT 'event' AS kind, "Id" AS event_id, "SortableUniqueId" AS suid, "Tags" AS tags FROM dcb_events WHERE "ServiceId"='sekiban-dcb-g60-w155-c' AND "Id" IN ('01a071bb-678c-788b-86b2-e51ca56c3db3','01a071bb-6f65-795d-984a-02c4fba48363'); SELECT 'receipt' AS kind, event_id, membership_tag, obligation_sequence, received_at FROM serialized_dcb_global_receipts WHERE service_id='sekiban-dcb-g60-w155-c' AND event_id IN ('01a071bb-678c-788b-86b2-e51ca56c3db3','01a071bb-6f65-795d-984a-02c4fba48363') ORDER BY event_id, membership_tag, obligation_sequence; SELECT 'attempt' AS kind, event_id, partition_tag, outcome, admission_started_at, admission_finished_at FROM serialized_dcb_g65_admission_attempts WHERE service_id='sekiban-dcb-g60-w155-c' AND event_id IN ('01a071bb-678c-788b-86b2-e51ca56c3db3','01a071bb-6f65-795d-984a-02c4fba48363') ORDER BY event_id, admission_started_at;
